newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's TIM says GSM clients total 1.46 mln.
newsitem.headline: Italy's TIM says GSM clients total 1.46 mln.

text.p: Italian mobile telephone service operator Telecom Italia Mobile (TIM) said in a statement 260,000 new clients subscribed to its GSM service in October and clients now totalled 1.462 million.

TIM, which was spun off from state controlled Telecom Italia last year, said the trend for November was also for growth, with 140,000 of its new TIM Card paycards activated in just 14 days, the same amount for the whole of October.
TIM competes in the Italian mobile market with Olivetti-led consortium Omnitel Pronto-Italia.
